name: matlab__matlab-mcp-server
description: Work with MATLAB on your device.
instructions:
This MCP server runs on your device. You need [MATLAB](https://www.mathworks.com/products/matlab.html) R2021a or newer and the [MATLAB MCP Server](https://github.com/matlab/matlab-mcp-server) installed locally.

Add `--initial-working-folder=` with your project folder to start MATLAB in it, for example `--initial-working-folder=$HOME/Projects/my-model`.

If MATLAB is not on your PATH, add `--matlab-root=` with your MATLAB folder, for example `--matlab-root=/Applications/MATLAB_R2026b.app`.
